title: Energy in a larger inductance
hook: Change inductance and predict stored magnetic energy.
misconception: stored magnetic energy stays fixed when inductance doubles.
objective: Apply U = LI²/2 to compare stored magnetic energy when inductance changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With an ideal inductor with fixed current magnitude, U = LI²/2. When inductance doubles, stored magnetic energy becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model U = LI²/2; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider an ideal inductor with fixed current magnitude, with a nonzero initial result. If inductance triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on stored magnetic energy?
recall.why: Apply U = LI²/2 under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
